notes_for_editor: The 2003 date is the register's YEAR_CONSTRUCTED for the present structure. The 1958-1967 items show a Whitefish tower staffed before 2003, so the steel tower was not the first at this name; no source read says whether the earlier tower stood on the same spot. The newspaper items are read through a lookout-history site that quotes the Peace River Record Gazette; the newspapers themselves were not read. Brief's access 'closed' is not stated by any source, so no access level is recorded; visit.drive_up comes from the register's ACCESS_MODE 'drive'. Agency is left out: the brief's 'Alberta Wildfire' is not named in any source read for this site. The staffing as_of 1967 is the latest item found; current staffing is unknown. Tower men are not named in the story.
